prompt: IMPORTANT: plain live television look. No sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Nobody wears boxing gloves or MMA gloves - bare knuckles with thin hand wraps only, the cat's paws are bare fur. Anatomy must stay correct at all times: no twisted or inverted joints, no bending knees or elbows the wrong way, no rubbery limbs, no extra limbs. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-1: the giant ginger tabby cat and the female fighter in blue stand apart at clean punching range, both fully visible. SECONDS 1-4: the cat throws a long combination of five separate open-paw strikes, one clearly after another, driving her backwards in a straight line. She keeps her guard up, covers and retreats, NEVER throws a punch and never touches the cat. They never clinch. SECONDS 4-5: the cat lands one huge open-paw slap and she is thrown backwards COMPLETELY OUT OF THE FRAME, disappearing off the edge of the shot. After that she is NOT visible in the shot at all - the canvas where she was is empty. SECONDS 5-8: the cat is alone in frame. It stays standing upright on its hind legs the whole time - it never drops onto all four paws and never changes size. It raises one paw high toward the roaring crowd and holds it, slowly turns its head to look around the arena, then lowers the paw and licks it once. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes are sharp, the crowd and the banners behind the ring stay out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real fight speed, natural motion blur. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, five separate slaps as the paws land, one heavy impact on the final slap, then the crowd explodes and keeps roaring. No music, no commentary, no speech.
